_comment: Fused all-reduce (custom_all_reduce) size guards keyed by aiter git commit. Consumed by scripts/fusion_candidate_harness.py to cross-check the analyst-declared environment_api_inventory.collective_fused_ar_guard.threshold_bytes so the threshold number itself cannot drift/hallucinate between runs. Add a new entry when a new aiter build is inspected; verify the expr against the installed source before adding.

a6bb499375849eec45d68c5ccaebc8865fd422c0.notes: 8*1024*8192 = 67108864 bytes = 64 MiB. Tensor >= this falls back to split all-reduce + separate rmsnorm. 1-stage vs 2-stage is a separate switch (total_bytes <= 128*1024) and does not affect availability.
